brief.topic: Your model API will have a bad day. Plan for it
brief.audience: PMs and engineers shipping features on hosted model APIs

coreInsight: A demo assumes the model API always answers fast, but in production it will sometimes be slow, rate-limited or down, so the feature needs a designed bad-day path: a timeout, one retry, a tested fallback and an honest message.

hooks.text: Your model API will go down. Then what?
hooks.notes: Certain to happen; the question invites the plan.

hooks.text: Your AI feature has a single point of failure.

caption.opening: Your demo assumed the model API always answers, and answers fast. In production it will sometimes be slow, rate-limited or down.
body:
Design the bad-day path before launch:
→ A timeout users can live with
→ One retry, then stop (retry storms make outages worse)
→ A fallback model you’ve run your eval set on
→ A plain message when everything fails
An honest “this answer may be limited right now” beats a spinner that never ends.

claims.text: Production LLM features should handle slow, rate-limited or unavailable model APIs with timeouts, bounded retries, an evaluated fallback model and a clear degraded-mode message.
